requirement: A WO WordPress demo keeps every template section: missing facts read "Coming soon", the hand-off cannot take a section off, and demo QA fails a lost section or an off-site button

oracle.ref: PR #1630 (fix); fix evidence: Dev WO build of a JA Restaurant WP site (22/10/2026): the build hid dish groups, tabs and all but one dish; the hand-off agent's first turn rewrote whole pages (Home 65 KB to 5 KB, Menu 38 KB to 0.7 KB) and the demo QA gate passed.
oracle.invariant: 0 failures. A JA Restaurant 1.0.1 WO build keeps every dish item: unsourced items take a neutral name, an empty description and badge (badge class removed) and price "Coming soon"; no section is hidden. A block pruneBody would cut for naming the template's company stays with "Coming soon" text, also when every section of the page names it. The hand-off prompt lists each kept page's sections with their action and grants no hide/remove permission. structure-kept fails on a lost features-intro or subscribe section, on fewer dish items and on an unread baseline page; shorter text passes with a note; a baseline with no marks passes. cta-real fails a booking button to another page or off the site and any button leaving the demo; the plan's Contact page passes and a contact slug is not enough when the plan names one.
